title: lobelia delisseana
intro: Lobelia delisseana, commonly known as Chinese lobelia, is a plant species in the Lobelia genus. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Chinese lobelia include its anti-inflammatory, anti-asthmatic, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve symptoms of bronchitis, coughs, and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Chinese lobelia include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
